description:
Create, list, show and delete thread files: Projects, Processes and Topics.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list threads, open ones only by default
  show THREAD [--json] — show one thread file
  new --name NAME --kind KIND --category CATEGORY [--currency CCY] [--rate N] — create a thread file
  delete THREAD -y — permanently delete a thread file

Args:
  QUERY   optional fuzzy search; results are ranked by similarity
  THREAD  thread name or 'Kind/Name'

Flags:
  list:
    --all            include paused and closed threads
    --json           JSON output
  show:
    --json           JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME      required. Becomes the filename. Must not contain '/' or start with '.'.
    --kind KIND      required. One of: project, process, topic
    --category CAT   required. One of: professional, personal, voluntary
    --currency CCY   3-letter ISO code. Default currency for `hours` and `payments`; makes the thread billable.
    --rate N         default hourly rate for `hours`; requires --currency
  delete:
    -y, --yes        required to confirm

Examples:
  ["list", "sgb", "--json"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "2500"]

Notes:
  Nothing prompts. delete is destructive and refuses to run without -y.
  A thread must exist before notes, buffer entries, hours or payments can reference it.
  Exit 1: empty name, a name containing '/' or starting with '.', thread already exists, --rate without --currency, or delete without -y.

BLOCKED: delete. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
